naming.name: Trinacria
naming.lineage: marine: Trinacria Heiberg 1863 is an extinct marine centric diatom genus (family Hemiaulaceae; type species T. regina, Eocene, Denmark; AlgaeBase lists it as marine). The genus takes the Greek name of Sicily, 'three-pointed', whose emblem is the triskelion: three legs turning one way, reversed when the disc is turned over, which is what the half-turn kappa does to this flow's two halves
